step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Nodes: Visual inspection of the whiteboard shows Source DB (ThirdParty), AWS Glue (Glue), Redshift (RedShift), S3 (S3), DynamoDB (DynamoDB), SageMaker (SageMaker), API Gateway (ApiGateway), Lambda (Lambda), and Mobile App (UserConsumerMobile).
2. Identify Edges: Arrow lines depict ingestion flow from Source DB -> AWS Glue -> Redshift, S3, DynamoDB. S3 feeds into Redshift (Redshift Spectrum). Redshift has bidirectional arrows with SageMaker. The serving flow starts at Mobile App -> API Gateway -> Lambda -> SageMaker.
3. Sequence: Flow 0 represents ingestion and model training. Flow 1 represents end-user inference requests.
